text.name: rse_ep_powerline_description
text.text: County dispatch: a car has hit a utility pole. The pole and the wires are down across the road, and the driver is still in the car. Traffic is stopping. The utility crew is on its way. Can you help?

text.name: rse_line_hint_wait
text.text: Stay back: the wires may be live. Set up cones and warning lights. The utility crew needs about a minute and a half to cut the power.

text.name: rse_line_hint_work
text.text: Help the driver out and take the car to a recovery point. Walk up to each wire (look for the pins) and roll it up. Bring the pole in, cut with a chainsaw if it has to fit. Both parts earn a bonus.

text.name: rse_line_danger
text.text: Keep back! Those wires may be live. If you stay this close, it will cut your pay.

text.name: rse_line_dangerCut
text.text: You stayed too close to live wires, so the county has cut your pay by %d%%.

text.name: rse_line_powerOff
text.text: Utility crew: the power is off, and it is safe to work.

text.name: rse_line_rollUp
text.text: Hold to roll up the wire

text.name: rse_line_stillLive
text.text: Not yet: the power is still on. The utility crew needs about %d more seconds.

text.name: rse_line_wireDone
text.text: The wire is rolled up. Wires left: %d.

text.name: rse_line_pieceIn
text.text: That piece of the pole is in. Pieces left: %d.

text.name: rse_line_poleIn

text.name: rse_crash_lineDone
text.text: The pole and the wires are cleared. Bring in the car too for a %d%% bonus. If you don't, another contractor takes over after %s; the settings panel (H) can hand it over sooner.

text.name: rse_guide_title_line
text.text: Downed power lines

text.name: rse_guide_line_1
text.text: A car has hit a utility pole. Stay back until the utility crew has cut the power: the wires may be live, and staying too close costs you pay. Set up your cones and lights while you wait.

text.name: rse_guide_line_2
text.text: Once the power is off, help the driver out and take the car to a recovery point. A pin shows each wire: walk up to it, anywhere along it, and hold the key to roll it up.

text.name: rse_guide_line_3
text.text: The pole is a real log. If it has to fit on something, cut it with a chainsaw: stand beside it and aim across it. Bring every piece to a recovery point. Do both parts for a bonus.

text.name: rse_crash_hint_load
text.text: Two jobs, do one or both: prepare, right and tow in the wrecked trailer; or bring the bales to the marked recovery point. Both earn a bonus.

text.name: rse_crash_arrivedLoad
text.text: Bales on the road: %d.

text.name: rse_load_call_small
text.text: The load is small bales, so a pickup truck and your own hands can handle it.

text.name: rse_load_call_big
text.text: The load is big bales, so bring a front loader or a telehandler and something to carry them on.

text.name: rse_load_arrived_small
text.text: Carry the small bales by hand into a pickup bed, or into the trailer once it is back on its wheels. Each one that reaches a recovery point pays.

text.name: rse_load_arrived_big
text.text: The big bales need a front loader or a telehandler. Each one that reaches a recovery point pays.

text.name: rse_crash_trailerDoneBales
text.text: The trailer is in. Bring in the bales too for a %d%% bonus. If you don't, another contractor takes over after %s; the settings panel (H) can hand them over sooner.

text.name: rse_crash_balesDone
text.text: The bales are in. Bring in the trailer too for a %d%% bonus. If you don't, another contractor takes over after %s; the settings panel (H) can hand it over sooner.

text.name: rse_wreck_hint_deliver
text.text: Take it to the marked recovery point. Its engine stays off. Strap it to a vehicle (K) and it follows you, or use a winch. For a rollback, strap it to the bed and reel it on (N).

text.name: rse_set_guide
text.text: Open the guide

text.name: rse_guide_title
text.text: Roadside Emergencies guide

text.name: rse_guide_help
text.text: Left and Right: page. Enter: next page. H or Esc: close.

text.name: rse_guide_page
text.text: Page %d of %d

text.name: rse_guide_welcome_1
text.text: You are the local contractor county dispatch calls when something goes wrong on the road: animals hit by traffic, wrecks, rollovers, spilled loads and storm damage.

text.name: rse_guide_welcome_2
text.text: Calls come by themselves every so often, from anywhere on the map's roads. A pager asks whether you will take the job. Saying no costs nothing. Say yes and follow the marker.

text.name: rse_guide_welcome_3
text.text: You can come back to this guide at any time: press H on foot and choose "Open the guide". The same menu has all the settings.

text.name: rse_guide_title_calls
text.text: Calls and pay

text.name: rse_guide_calls_1
text.text: A job pays when it is done, and the progress bar shows how far along you are. Only one job runs at a time.

text.name: rse_guide_calls_2
text.text: Turn on your hazards or beacons at the scene for extra pay.

text.name: rse_guide_calls_3
text.text: A call you don't reach in time goes to another contractor, with no pay and no penalty. You can also hand any job over from the settings (H), for example if a wreck gets stuck.

text.name: rse_guide_calls_4
text.text: You can save during a job. It comes back when you load.

text.name: rse_guide_title_animals
text.text: Dead animals

text.name: rse_guide_animals_1
text.text: Clear the road. Small animals can be dragged by hand with the activate key. Heavy ones need a strap or a machine.

text.name: rse_guide_animals_2
text.text: Load an animal on any vehicle for the full pay, then take it to a drop-off point. That pays for the haul-off, minus a disposal fee. The shop is always a drop-off point.

text.name: rse_guide_animals_3
text.text: Only moving it to the roadside pays very little. An animal left behind is marked on your map, and you get reminders. If you leave it too long, the county collects it and bills you.

text.name: rse_guide_animals_4
text.text: Animal bodies work like bales, so front loaders, forks, cranes, trailers, tension belts and autoload mods can all handle them. A cow is heavy, so a small crane can't lift one.

text.name: rse_guide_title_strap
text.text: The recovery strap

text.name: rse_guide_strap_1
text.text: On foot, aim at a dead animal or a prepared wreck and press K to hook the strap there. Then aim at a vehicle and press K again to attach the other end. Aim at nothing to put the strap away.

text.name: rse_guide_strap_2
text.text: While you are near a strap, hold N to reel it in and M to let it out. Reeling in pulls a wreck up onto a rollback, and letting out lets it roll back down.

text.name: rse_guide_strap_3
text.text: To right a wreck lying on its side, hook it high on its upper side, attach the strap to a vehicle, and pull it over.

text.name: rse_guide_wrecks_1
text.text: Walk up to a wreck and prepare it for recovery first. Its engine stays off, because it is wrecked, so you tow it or load it.

text.name: rse_guide_wrecks_2
text.text: Once it stands on its wheels, strap it to a vehicle. The strap hooks where you aim and pulls nothing until you reel it or drive off. It pulls along the line, and the front wheels turn toward the pull, so a pull at an angle swings the wreck around. A trailer can't steer, so while you reel, it moves over toward the line. When you tow, the strap moves to the end of the wreck, the line shortens by itself unless you reeled it by hand, and the wreck brakes when you stop.

text.name: rse_guide_wrecks_3
text.text: Wrecks and bales must reach a recovery point before you are paid for them. The marker shows the way.

text.name: rse_guide_wrecks_4
text.text: Some jobs have two parts, such as a trailer and its bales. Do one and another contractor takes the other after a while, or do both for a bonus.

text.name: rse_guide_title_loads
text.text: Spilled bales

text.name: rse_guide_loads_1
text.text: The call tells you what the load is. Small bales can be carried by hand, so a pickup truck is enough. Big bales pay more per bale, but they need a front loader or a telehandler.

text.name: rse_guide_loads_2
text.text: You don't need a second trip for a trailer job. Get the trailer back on its wheels, put the bales in it, and tow it all to the recovery point. A storm job has no trailer, so bring your own and make as many trips as you need.

text.name: rse_guide_loads_3
text.text: Each bale that reaches a recovery point pays, even if you hand over the rest of the job in the settings (H). A bale pays more when the bales are all you bring in.

text.name: rse_guide_title_loose
text.text: Loose animals

text.name: rse_guide_loose_1
text.text: At a livestock trailer crash, live animals wander off. They stop to graze, and they shy away when you come at them.

text.name: rse_guide_loose_2
text.text: Walk up to one and use the activate key to catch it. It follows you on a lead. Bring it next to your own livestock trailer and use the key again to load it.

text.name: rse_guide_loose_3
text.text: You lead one at a time. It gets away if you run too far ahead, and it stays behind if you get in a vehicle. Once loaded, the animals are yours to sell at the animal dealer.

text.name: rse_guide_title_kit
text.text: Cones and barricades

text.name: rse_guide_kit_1
text.text: At a call, press U on foot to open the scene kit. I picks the next item, L places it or picks up what you aim at, and holding O turns it. They are free, and they stop traffic.

text.name: rse_guide_kit_2
text.text: Whatever you place, you pick up again. Until you do, the county keeps calling and no new call comes.

text.name: rse_guide_title_markers
text.text: Map markers

text.name: rse_guide_markers_1
text.text: A green animal is a loose animal, a red ! is a dead animal left behind, and an orange cone is one of your cones or barricades. A blue number is your own drop-off point, shown while you have something to bring.

text.name: rse_guide_markers_2
text.text: Click a marker on the map to see what it is and teleport there. You can also have the county collect a dead animal, for the usual bill, or remove a drop-off point.

text.name: rse_guide_markers_3
text.text: Add your own drop-off points in the settings (H).

text.name: rse_guide_title_mods
text.text: Works well with

text.name: rse_guide_mods_1
text.text: You don't need any of these mods, but they suit the work. The ones named here have been tested with Roadside Emergencies.

text.name: rse_guide_mods_2
text.text: T880 Rollback by Roughneck Modding Crew: pull a wreck onto the bed with the strap (K) and the reel keys (N and M), belt it down, and drive it in.

text.name: rse_guide_mods_3
text.text: Better Winch by ThundR: its winch hooks dead animals and wrecks. UniversalAutoload by loki_79: it loads them onto the trailers it supports.

text.name: rse_guide_mods_4
text.text: Front loaders, bale grabs and crane trailers all handle dead animals, but a small crane can't lift a cow.

text.name: rse_scene_deliver
text.text: Take the animals you removed to a disposal point for extra pay.

text.name: rse_ep_missing
text.text: Roadside Emergencies: the Emergency Pack DLC is missing, so there are no emergencies.
